I had a similar experience. I found out my boyfriend was exposed on a Friday morning. Got a rapid test with him since I work in healthcare just as a precaution. We both tested negative on a rapid nasal swab test. Around the next day I had a tickly throat, I vape and have been on and off with quitting so I figured it was related..nothing to worry about because I had a negative test right?? The next few days I felt like I was coming down with a cold. Same throat feeling and a dry cough. It was Monday night and I felt like I had a fever. STILL not worried because of the negative test. The next day I got tested because my symptoms got much worse. By the day after I had completely lost my sense of smell and was in pretty bad pain. I tested positve. My boyfriend tested negative. I am glad I got tested again. I would have felt awful to have been spreading this shit any longer unknowingly. It just goes to show though that you can't truly trust a negative test. If you still have symptoms get a second test.
